payload.reason: The evidence provides specific machine learning and deep learning methods used for Recognizing Question Entailment (RQE) in the context of question answering systems.

claims.text: Logistic Regression is used as a machine learning method for RQE, achieving high performance in question-question similarity tasks.
Neural networks, including architectures like Bi-LSTM, GRU, and CNNs, are employed as deep learning methods for RQE, showing effectiveness on larger datasets.
The study compares the performance of these methods on various datasets, indicating their applicability in both open-domain and clinical settings.
